title: Quick Grilled Portuguese Chicken Skewers
description: A Mediterranean-friendly dish featuring marinated chicken, lardons, and a hint of milk chocolate, grilled to perfection on a robata grill
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through
While the chicken is cooking, melt the milk chocolate chips in a small saucepan over low heat
Stir the rendered lardons into the melted chocolate until well combined
Brush the chocolate-lardon mixture onto the grilled chicken during the last minute of cooking
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional lardons if desired
